description:
Get the signed-in user's account details, plan and settings. Needs a login session: call start_login, then wait_for_login until it reports success. An API key alone cannot read this — for the key's own account use get_self_api_key or get_settings.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account, signed in: call start_login, show the user its challenge, then wait_for_login, then call this tool again. Authenticating this client alone does NOT open this tool.
name: get_current_user

outputSchema.description: The signed-in account, as `GET /auth/me` answers it.

avatar_url.description: The primary sub-account's avatar, else any sub-account's; null when none has one.

deletion.description: Where the account stands with deletion; the dashboard routes a locked session to the lock page from it.

login_email.description: The email this session signed in with; absent for a phone sign-in.

login_phone.description: The phone this session signed in with, else the account's login phone; absent for an account with neither.

phone_number.description: The account's login phone, when it has one.
